task: Phase 2d Task 5b -- what makes 2c's field 40.79, probed on 2c's own fixture
why_a_probe_and_not_a_rung: The difficulty ladder puts 2c's own white/sigma of 0.45-0.71 at about 28 iterations per
point, against the 40.79 2c measured. So the noise floor accounts for roughly 3.5 of a
16.4-iteration gap and something else accounts for the remaining ~12.
A rung at white/sigma = 1.0 would sit at 30.5 iterations, still well below 2c's range, and a
null there would leave open whether an artifact appears at 40.79 -- the pre-decided stop was
written against 'difficulty reaches 2c's range' and would not cleanly apply.
2c's fixture is IN THE TREE. (j4): an existing measurement is evidence, and reading it costs
under an hour where approaching it costs 15 hours a step.

instrument.what_varies_between_rows: the DATA only -- every setting is fitted through the shipped fit with the shipped candidate set

the_four_settings: 1. 2c's field exactly as its harness builds it -- the target
2. the same, with 2c's signal (2.0 + 0.3 x (t - t.mean())) removed from the draw
3. the same, on 2d's 31-day time axis instead of exact months
4. 2d's own parameters at the same point count, as the same-session comparison arm

readings.name: does 40.79 reproduce on 2c's own fixture, under the shipped fit?
prediction: Setting 1 lands in [35, 46] iterations per point -- reproducing 2c's 40.79 within the
spread a 16-point sample carries. The mechanism: it is the same construction, the same
record length and the same candidate set, fitted by the same shipped fit.
Setting 4 lands near 24-26, reproducing 2d's own difficulty in the same session, so the
gap is measured once rather than across two runs.

reading: 2c's 40.79 does not reproduce on 2c's own construction under today's fit. Then the
number is not a property of the fixture but of something that has since changed --
ALGORITHM_VERSION moved to '2' at 2c Task 5, the optimizer's ladder or its convergence
test may have moved with it -- and the target 2d has been chasing is a figure from a
code path that no longer exists.
ACTION: that is a finding about the record, not about the field. Report it, and retire
40.79 as a target rather than building a rung to approach it.
2c's fixture is HARDER under today's fit than when it was measured. Same conclusion
about comparability as the clause below, in the opposite direction, and the same
action: the target is not a fixed point.

readings.name: how much of the gap is the SIGNAL 2c adds and 2d does not?
prediction: Setting 2 -- 2c's field without its signal -- lands MATERIALLY BELOW setting 1, taking
back at least a third of the gap between settings 1 and 4.
The mechanism, stated so it can be wrong: 2c adds 2.0 + 0.3 x (t - t.mean()) to every
series, which over a 52-year record is a rise of ~15.6 against sigma ~1. The signal is
profiled out by the concentrated objective, but the MOMENT LADDER that produces the cold
start is what sets the iteration count, and a start computed on a series dominated by a
trend is a worse start. 2d's field carries no signal at all while its config fits a

refuted_from_below.when: setting 2 is within 2 iterations of setting 1
reading: The signal is not what makes 2c hard, and the ladder's own arithmetic is then the whole
story: something in rho, the parameter spread within a regime, or the sigma level
accounts for the remaining ~12 iterations. The probe has narrowed it by elimination,
which is what it is for.

refuted_from_above.when: setting 2 falls to or below setting 4
reading: The signal accounts for the WHOLE gap, and 2d's difficulty could be raised to 2c's by
adding a trend to the field rather than by touching the noise floor at all.
That would be the cheapest possible repair and it is worth knowing precisely.

readings.name: the time axis is not the difference
prediction: Setting 3 is within one iteration of setting 1. 31-day steps against exact months is a
1.9% difference in spacing and rho is expressed in years, so rho in SAMPLES barely moves
-- and the ladder already measured rho worth about one iteration across a factor of 6.7.
This is a null, and it is measured because it is free rather than because it is in doubt.

refuted.when: setting 3 differs from setting 1 by more than 2 iterations
reading: The axis matters more than the ladder implies, which would make every cross-fixture
comparison in 2d and 2c suspect -- both were built on different axes. It would also
make to_decimal_years part of the difficulty rather than only of fit identity.

what_this_probe_does_not_establish: Nothing about hysteresis, warm starts or the artifact. It measures how hard a fit is.
Nothing about spatial structure: independent series, no boundary, no neighbours.
And no number here is a 2d result -- it is a reading of 2c's fixture, taken to decide whether
2d's builder can reach that difficulty at all.
